traditional: A hard contact. Love, money, and pleasure works against action, conflict, and heat - obstruction, friction, and strained outcomes in these areas. The benefic Venus tempers the malefic Mars.
modern: Attraction meets drive. Desire, and the channeling of energy into pleasure, art, or pursuit. The conjunction can either fuse charm and drive or have the two cancel out. Psychologically the opposition is inner tension to integrate: Bad timing in romance, indecision, and friction between wanting and acting. The growth is owning both sides instead of splitting them.

cyclic.meaning: Connection and drive reach full awareness and face each other: culmination, objectivity, fulfillment or confrontation.

business: Friction in this area. Charm plus initiative; manage the push-pull between attraction and aggression.
shadow: Indulgence and vanity collides with anger and recklessness; forcing or splitting it instead of working it through.
arcApplying: A confrontation builds; the other side comes fully into view.
arcSeparating: The standoff resolves into balance or a split.
base: Wanting each other does not automatically mean wanting the same thing from the connection.

readerCopy.body: Wanting each other does not automatically mean wanting the same thing from the connection. When Venus opposes Mars, attraction and friction face each other directly, making differences around pace, commitment, boundaries, money, or expectations more charged because chemistry is still present. Desire can be obvious while agreement remains unresolved. The connection becomes clearer when attraction stops being used as evidence that one side should eventually give in.
